rca.defect: request_bodies_from_plan pinned the observed Blue generation only for the causal crossover and actor-receipt-required requests. The other ordinary bridge requests carried expected_route_generation=0 while the new exact39 online terminal gate correctly required every pre-switch bridge response to be bound to old Blue generation E.
rca.effect: The fail-closed gate rejected a normal Blue response as an expected-generation mismatch before the route-switch transaction. No canonical matrix or acceptance credit started.
rca.remediation: Pin every request in the frozen bridge set to the observed pre-switch Blue generation and enforce any positive expected_route_generation before incrementing server in-flight accounting. Preserve stale-generation rejection without leaking in-flight capacity.
